_readme: Update notices for the Now Playing OS widgets.
Each widget's config app fetches this file on load and compares the version
here against its own. If this one is higher it shows a small notice telling
the owner to re-download from their Etsy purchases page.
To announce an update: bump the version, write one short line of notes, and
commit. That is the whole release process for the widget itself - no server,
no mailing list, nothing to maintain.
Keep notes under about ten words; it renders on one line.
The version must match the WIDGET_VERSION constant in the widget's HTML.

nowplaying-os.notes: bridge support, artwork lookup, width control
